Is the Book of Enoch Scripture… or a deception?

We look at the Book of Enoch, exposing its contradictions, false doctrines, and why it does not belong in the Bible. Special guest Brad from Strange Normal joins the show as we break down how spiritual deception in the last days is preparing the world to fall for a massive alien/UFO lie rooted in ancient demonic doctrines—including Enoch.

Key Topics Covered:
The origins of the Book of Enoch and why it was never part of the biblical canon
Why the claim that angels mated with women is unbiblical and biologically impossible
The false claim that Enoch is the “Son of Man” (a title that belongs only to Jesus)
Direct contradictions between Enoch and Scripture:
Sin blamed on angels instead of Adam (Romans 5:12 vs Enoch 6:28–10:8)
Angels marrying women vs. Jesus’ clear teaching in Matthew 22:30
Enoch’s vision of a disembodied spirit (Abel) contradicting the biblical truth about death and the resurrection
The real meaning of “sons of God” and “daughters of men” in Genesis 6
Why Satan can't create life and the Nephilim were not angel-human hybrids
How the book of Enoch plays into the coming great deception involving UFOs, fallen angels, and false signs and wonders

The Book of Enoch is being used to lay the foundation for the Alien Gospel—a lie that will cause millions to unite with the enemy in a war against Christ.
